note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: We missed our plan for net new annual recurring revenue last year and need to know where revenue was lost.

answers.common.decision: Whether to put next year's effort into acquisition or retention; the chief revenue officer decides.
answers.common.deadline: Next year's revenue plan is due next month.
answers.common.audience: The chief revenue officer and the marketing, sales and customer success leads.
answers.common.materials: Marketing generated 4,000 leads and we won 200 new customers. The average new customer is worth $15,000 a year. We lost $1.2 million of annual recurring revenue to churn. Our plan was $2.5 million of net new annual recurring revenue.
answers.data-analytics.data: Marketing lead counts, CRM closed deals and billing churn records for last year.
answers.data-analytics.question: Where in the funnel and after the sale revenue was lost against plan.
